0 = aucune (le lecteur ne dépasse jamais: 0 = none (the player never goes above the starting quality). Default: 0.
Après une baisse de qualité, le temps pe: After a quality drop, how long the quality does not go back up, even if the player asks for it: a network going up and down does not keep changing the picture. 0 = no wait. Default: 30.
Aucune lecture concernée depuis le démar: No playback concerned since the server started.
Aucune qualité en dessous : l'image n'en: No quality below this: the picture would no longer be worth it. Default: 700.
Chaque qualité a au moins cette part du: Each quality has at least this share of the bitrate of the one above (0.5 = half), and the ladder always goes down to the minimum bitrate, in regular steps. A ratio rather than a step in Mb/s: perceived quality loss follows the ratio of bitrates (10 to 9.5 Mb/s is invisible, 1 to 0.5 Mb/s is not). Higher: gentler but more numerous steps. Default: 0.5.
Descendre d'avance quand le débit ne suf: Step down ahead when the bitrate no longer suffices
Flux adaptatif plutôt que lecture direct: Adaptive stream instead of direct play (experimental)
Jellyfin mesure le réseau une fois, au d: Jellyfin measures the network once, when playback starts. If it improves afterwards, higher qualities can be offered, never beyond the file. They exceed the maximum bitrate set in the player: leave this at 0 if your users set it to save data.
Jellyfin {0} : pas encore testé avec ce: Jellyfin {0}: not yet tested with this plugin.
La playlist HLS de cette version de Jell: The HLS playlist of this Jellyfin version does not have the expected shape: the plugin leaves it untouched.
Le réseau local suffit presque toujours: The local network is almost always enough; “all” helps with weak Wi-Fi or powerline. Default: outside the local network.
Le serveur chronomètre l'envoi de chaque: The server times the sending of every segment (the player's real bitrate, with no extra download) and infers how far ahead the player is from the rhythm of its requests: always, for the overlay and the status. When enabled, it also chooses the quality sent: it waits before going back up after a drop, and steps down ahead when the bitrate no longer suffices, while the player still has some buffer. Stepping down at the player's request is always immediate; never two encodings for one playback.
Le serveur pilote la qualité envoyée: The server controls the quality sent
Nombre maximal de qualités sous celle de: Maximum number of qualities below the starting one; if more would be needed to reach the minimum bitrate, the gap widens. 0 = none. Default: 4.
Pendant une lecture dans le navigateur,: During playback in the browser, an overlay shows the current quality, the bitrate actually received segment by segment, the buffer ahead, the displayed picture, dropped frames, the qualities offered and the latest changes. To understand a stall; TV apps do not show it.
Qui la voit pendant une lecture (elle se: Who sees it during playback (it closes with ×). Applied when the player's page is reloaded. Default: off.
Sous la qualité que Jellyfin choisit au: Below the quality Jellyfin chooses when playback starts, lower qualities are offered to the player. A quality that is not used costs nothing: it is only encoded if the player switches to it.
Un fichier lu directement n'a qu'une qua: A file played directly has a single quality: if the network weakens, the picture stops. This option sends the players concerned through the adaptive stream; the video is copied as is while the network keeps up (almost no work for the server), and transcoded only when the player steps down.
Une par ligne (ou séparées par des virgu: One per line (or comma-separated): an app whose name contains this text keeps Jellyfin's stream as is. Empty by default.
Une vraie échelle de qualités dans les f: A real quality ladder in Jellyfin's streams: when the network weakens, the player switches to a lower quality without a cut, and goes back up when it recovers. The new quality is loaded before the switch, at a segment boundary, with the same audio track and the same subtitles.
le serveur ne pilote pas la qualité: the server does not control the quality
pas de flux HLS (lecture directe, ou flu: no HLS stream (direct play, or a stream without a ladder)
transcodage vidéo interdit au compte: video transcoding not allowed for the account
Pour les changements décidés par le serv: For changes the server decides (going back up, stepping down ahead); a drop asked by the player never waits. 0 = automatic: two and a half segments, between 6 and 30 s. Default: 0.
Une qualité n'est gardée ou atteinte que: A quality is kept or reached only if the measured bitrate exceeds its bitrate times this margin (1.25 = 25% headroom). Higher: more cautious, slightly lower picture. 0 = automatic: from the measured steadiness of the connection, between 1.1 and 2. Default: 0.
Aucune décision du serveur sur une seule: No server decision on a single measurement. 0 = automatic: enough to cover 6 s of video. Default: 0.
Démarrage d'un encodage sur ce serveur :: Encoder start on this server: {0} s (measured at quality changes).
